allow_user_scope.verdict_effect: False: every user-scope source is BLOCK.

allow_repo_tracked.verdict_effect: False: every tracked in-repo source is BLOCK.

allow_managed_scope.description: Organisation-managed scope sources (Claude Code managed CLAUDE.md) are permitted. Only claude-code defines a managed scope.
allow_managed_scope.verdict_effect: False: every managed-scope source is BLOCK.

allow_nested_on_demand.description: On-demand (nested / path-scoped) sources may enter the chain when their trigger fires.
allow_nested_on_demand.verdict_effect: False: on-demand sources are excluded from the effective chain (recorded as not applicable, not as BLOCK).

block_repo_untracked.description: Escalate a git-untracked in-repo source from WARN to BLOCK. Default false matches the PROJECT_BOOK.md §7.1 demo (untracked in-repo AGENTS.md is WARN). See SPEC-02 in profile_contract.json: §14.2 shows true only as an example policy, not the default.
block_repo_untracked.verdict_effect: True: GIT_UNTRACKED in-repo sources are BLOCK. False: they are WARN.

block_repo_modified.description: Escalate a git-modified tracked in-repo source from WARN to BLOCK. Default false matches §15 S05 (modified tracked is WARN).
block_repo_modified.verdict_effect: True: GIT_MODIFIED sources are BLOCK. False: they are WARN.

block_outside_repo.description: Sources whose resolved path lies outside the repository (and outside the user scope) are blocked.

block_symlink_escape.description: A source reached through a symlink/junction whose resolved path escapes the approved roots is blocked.

block_import_escape.description: An import/reference edge whose resolved target escapes the approved roots (or the repository / custom instructions directory for Copilot CLI) is blocked.
block_import_escape.verdict_effect: True: IMPORT_ESCAPE edges make the receipt BLOCK.

block_missing_reference.description: T001 addition (no named policy field in the spec; required by §15 S08, missing import is BLOCK). A reference to a file that does not exist is blocked.
block_missing_reference.verdict_effect: True: MISSING edges / MISSING sources are BLOCK.

warn_on_unspecified_precedence.description: Raise WARN when the receipt contains a source whose precedence kind is UNSPECIFIED (the harness defines no order for it).
warn_on_unspecified_precedence.verdict_effect: True: any UNSPECIFIED precedence in the chain is WARN (unless a BLOCK condition also applies).

treat_warn_as_block.description: CI strict mode: any WARN condition escalates the verdict to BLOCK.

allow_additional_directories.description: Permit Claude Code --add-dir / CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD sources (rule claude-code.additional-dirs). Default false is fail-closed: extra directories are not trusted unless explicitly allowed.
allow_additional_directories.verdict_effect: False: additional-directory sources are excluded from the effective chain.

verdict_derivation.BLOCK: Any source whose trust is OUTSIDE_REPO, SYMLINK_ESCAPE or IMPORT_ESCAPE while the corresponding block_* field is true; any edge with allowed=false while block_import_escape or block_missing_reference is true; any user/managed/tracked source while its allow_* field is false; or treat_warn_as_block=true with a WARN condition present.
verdict_derivation.WARN: Any GIT_UNTRACKED in-repo source while block_repo_untracked is false; any GIT_MODIFIED source while block_repo_modified is false; any source with precedence kind UNSPECIFIED while warn_on_unspecified_precedence is true.
verdict_derivation.PASS: No BLOCK and no WARN condition applies.
verdict_derivation.INPUT_ERROR: The harness id/version is unknown, the CWD does not exist, or the policy JSON is invalid. Never a PASS.
verdict_derivation.UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE: The requested harness profile id is not one of codex / claude-code / copilot-cli, or its version is not the frozen version for that id.
verdict_derivation.INTERNAL_ERROR: Any unexpected failure. Fail-closed: never emit PASS/WARN on an internal error.
verdict_derivation.note: Derivation is defined over trust values and policy fields only. Policy never changes which files are discovered; it only changes the verdict for discovered files.
